items.raw_excerpt: Kerala's 'My Police Station' initiative, launching August 15, aims to enhance citizen engagement, accessibility, and accountability in policing.
items.summary_en: Kerala will launch a program called 'My Police Station' on August 15. It wants to bring police and citizens closer. The program focuses on easy access and open, fair policing.
items.summary_ko: 케랄라 주가 오는 8월 15일 '내 경찰서' 프로그램을 시작합니다. 이 프로그램은 경찰과 주민을 더 가깝게 만들고자 합니다. 경찰 서비스를 더 쉽게 이용하고, 더 공정하고 투명하게 만드는 것이 목표입니다.
items.title_en: Kerala starts 'My Police Station' for better citizen ties

items.raw_excerpt: NAKHON SAWAN, Thailand: Next to a mound of black earth, Myanmar refugees feed soil and rice seed into a clacking conveyor machine that arranges them into ready-made planting trays for Thai farms.The farmworkers are among their Thai boss's newest employees, with a fresh sense of job security after Thailand beg
items.summary_en: Myanmar refugees in Nakhon Sawan, Thailand feed soil and rice seed into a machine that makes planting trays for Thai farms. They are the newest employees of their Thai boss. With new Thai IDs, they can work legally and feel job security.
items.summary_ko: 태국 나콘사완에서 미얀마 난민들이 검은 흙더미 옆에서 흙과 볍씨를 트레이 만드는 기계에 넣어 태국 농장용 모종 트레이를 만들고 있다. 이들은 태국인 사장의 새 직원으로, 태국 신분증 덕분에 합법적으로 일하며 취업 안정감을 얻었다.

items.title_original: 'Don't have to hide': Thai IDs, legal work give hope to Myanmar refugees

items.raw_excerpt: Escritora baiana Maria do Carmo, que lança seu livro Trilhas de Alforria, diz que feiras literárias se tornam importante espaço de encontro cultural e resistência.
items.summary_en: The literary fair Flipelô started in Salvador with music, poetry, and many visitors. Bahia writer Maria do Carmo says book fairs are important places for culture and resistance. She is launching her book Trilhas de Alforria there.

items.summary_en: Saint-Galmier is a small town in the Loire area of France. It is known as the source of Badoit sparkling water. The Michelin Guide now names it one of the most beautiful detours in France.

items.raw_excerpt: A French MP has announced his intention to propose a new law to tax tobacco companies to pay for the cost of fighting France's increasing wildfires - his reasoning being that many fires are started accidentally by carelessly dropped cigarette butts.
items.summary_en: A French lawmaker wants a new law to tax tobacco companies. The tax money would pay for the cost of fighting wildfires in France. He says many fires start from carelessly dropped cigarette butts.

items.raw_excerpt: Zurich consistently gets high scores for its quality of living but also ranks among the most expensive cities in the world. Does one compensate for the other? Here's what readers of The Local told us.
items.summary_en: Zurich scores high for quality of living. It is also one of the most expensive cities in the world. The Local asked readers if one makes up for the other.

items.raw_excerpt: Para esta quinta-feira (6), o Alerta Rio prevê a atuação de áreas de instabilidade. Os ventos estarão moderados, entre 18,5 km/h e 51,9 km/h, com rajadas isoladas fortes.
items.summary_en: For Thursday (6), Rio's Alerta Rio system forecasts areas of instability. Winds will be moderate, between 18.5 km/h and 51.9 km/h, with some strong isolated gusts. Rio city returns to Stage 1 as the winds lose strength.

items.summary_en: City planners from Ippuc visited the Bairro Novo district office. They heard about the routines and needs of local communities. The visits help planners build better solutions for the city.

items.raw_excerpt: If you're visiting or staying in Italy for any length of time and are planning on doing some travelling, a generous neighbour or relative might offer you access to their vehicle. But what does the law say about driving someone else's car?
items.summary_en: Many people who visit or stay in Italy borrow a car from a friend or relative. But Italian law has rules about driving a car that belongs to someone else. You may need the owner's permission and the right insurance documents.

items.raw_excerpt: Beyond the complexities of tipping etiquette across cultures, tipping in Denmark can just be physically difficult. Here's how to handle it.
items.summary_en: Tipping in Denmark is rarely expected because service is usually included in the bill. Many places are cashless, so it can be physically hard to leave a tip. This guide explains how to handle tipping in Denmark.
items.summary_ko: 덴마크에서는 대부분 서비스 요금이 계산서에 이미 포함되어 있어 팁을 줄 필요가 거의 없다. 게다가 무현금 결제가 많아 팁을 남기기가 물리적으로도 어렵다. 이 기사는 덴마크에서 팁을 어떻게 다뤄야 하는지 설명한다.
items.title_en: What's the tipping culture in Denmark?
